dimensions.name: technical_depth
dimensions.description: A novel engineering solution, mechanism, dataset, or result the briefing can build on — real substance, not news about money or people.

anchors.example: New architecture, benchmark, dataset, or measured result, with enough mechanism to explain how it works.
Real engineering progress, but incremental or thin on mechanism.
Funding, personality, marketing, or press-release noise with no technical core.

dimensions.name: watchlist_fit
dimensions.description: How much of the configured watchlist the item actually touches.

anchors.example: Central to several monitored areas at once.
Touches none of the watchlist terms.

dimensions.name: timeliness
dimensions.description: How fresh the item is inside the selection window.

anchors.example: At or beyond the window's edge.

dimensions.name: corroboration
dimensions.description: How many independent outlets carry the same story.

anchors.example: Three or more distinct publishers carry it (the cap).
